candidate_decisions.title: Qwen Code 0.29.0
candidate_decisions.reason: Stable release materially advances failover recovery and isolated PR verification.

candidate_decisions.title: LiteLLM 1.108.20 LTS
candidate_decisions.reason: Stable LTS patch fixes cancelled-stream usage and historical audit queries.

candidate_decisions.title: Inkling 2 Mini independent evaluations
candidate_decisions.reason: Plotly and ITLab add material local quality and cost evidence.

candidate_decisions.title: Kintsugi-27B
candidate_decisions.reason: Material overlap update publishes runnable 12 GB bundles and reproducibility artifacts.

candidate_decisions.title: OpenAI adversarial distillation seven-day review
candidate_decisions.reason: No public evaluation set or independent reproduction changed WATCH.

candidate_decisions.title: MedChemBench seven-day review
candidate_decisions.reason: No released scorer or independent rerun changed WATCH.

candidate_decisions.title: MiniMax cryptanalysis seven-day review
candidate_decisions.reason: No cryptography-expert reproduction changed WATCH.

candidate_decisions.title: Fintan-9B November 27 update
candidate_decisions.reason: Narrow self-evaluation, no controlled independent reproduction and a learning engine mainly distributed as compiled binaries.

candidate_decisions.title: llama.cpp continuous builds b12830-b12833
candidate_decisions.reason: Useful parser and backend fixes do not justify a separate intelligence event.

candidate_decisions.title: Hy-Embodied-Apexio-1.0
candidate_decisions.reason: Official repository still has no model card, files, downloads or usable artifact.

candidate_decisions.title: Codex 0.174 alpha builds
candidate_decisions.reason: Only alpha builds were published; no stable release.

candidate_decisions.title: Reported GPT-6.2 allowance changes
candidate_decisions.reason: No first-party policy or usage-limit statement verified the reported percentages.

candidate_decisions.title: Reported Claude research-task sabotage
candidate_decisions.reason: No reproducible artifact or first-party incident report verified the claim.

candidate_decisions.title: Reported OpenAI-Apple litigation
candidate_decisions.reason: No court docket or party filing was verified and no broad technical consequence was established.

candidate_decisions.title: Other fixed-monitor changes
candidate_decisions.reason: Hash changes reflected old releases, counters or page rendering without new qualifying facts.

candidate_decisions.title: Remaining research and active-discovery candidates
candidate_decisions.reason: No additional candidate combined freshness, public evidence and engineering value.

candidate_decisions.title: Exceptional general-news check
candidate_decisions.reason: No verified broad-impact general-news item met the exception standard.

candidate_decisions.title: Claude sabotaging ML research tasks?
candidate_decisions.reason: The social-media claim has no reproducible artifact or first-party incident report; wait for controlled evidence.

candidate_decisions.title: Claude Code sabotage: preliminary benchmarking
candidate_decisions.reason: The author labels the benchmark preliminary; no independent reproduction yet supports an intelligence event.

candidate_decisions.title: Google's DeepCrossAttention achieves comparable model quality up to 3x faster
candidate_decisions.reason: Google published the research post on 2026-11-23, before the overlap; the later HN submission is not a new development.

candidate_decisions.title: OpenAI cuts GPT-6.2 usage: Astra hits limits 40% faster, Sol 25% faster
candidate_decisions.reason: The reported allowance reductions are sourced to an unverified social post, with no first-party policy statement.

candidate_decisions.title: States sue SpaceX to stop Grok from generating child sex images, revenge porn
candidate_decisions.reason: The state complaint and press release were published on 2026-11-23, before the overlap; the later HN post is recirculation.

candidate_decisions.title: I'm Scared of AI
candidate_decisions.reason: Personal commentary adds no verifiable product, research, policy or engineering change.

candidate_decisions.title: Woman evicted after landlord's AI assistant told her she could delay rent
candidate_decisions.reason: A secondary anecdotal report without a primary case record does not meet the evidence threshold for the radar.

candidate_decisions.title: "What's Claude's fursona?" and other questions
candidate_decisions.reason: Informal model-personality commentary does not establish a material capability or engineering change.

candidate_decisions.title: Kimi for Science: More scientific ideas, made possible
candidate_decisions.reason: Kimi published the credit program on 2026-11-26 before the overlap; it offers conditional API credits but no new model capability.

candidate_decisions.title: GPT 6.2 Astra solves a historical mystery
candidate_decisions.reason: A single historical-research anecdote has no controlled evaluation or independently verified general capability result.

candidate_decisions.title: ai-sage/GigaChat4-37B-A4B
candidate_decisions.reason: The repository was created on 2026-11-20; the pre-overlap card update and noncommercial weights do not establish a new material change.
